page.overview:
Who is Zen and Singh?

Zen and Singh are two characters from the Street Fighter series who were introduced in a profile on the Shadaloo Combat Research Institute. They are two brothers who originate from India.

According to the Street Fighter V Aprils Fools page, he was the first director of the film The Eternal Ganga.
